fr_html: La rédaction de l'alinéa 1er, qui avait été réservée, est complétée par l'addition des mots „et que la partie, sans faute de sa part, pouvait ne pas connaître.”
en_html: The wording of the first Paragraph, which had been reserved, was completed by the addition of the words: “and of which the said party might be ignorant, through no fault of its own.”
